title: Photon energy from a wavelength
statement:
Calculate the energy per photon for $[$w]$ nm light. Use $h=6.626\times10^{-34}$ J·s and $c=2.998\times10^8$ m/s.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Using the numerical nm value as meters makes the energy a billion times too small.

hints: Use frequency c/λ or substitute directly in hc/λ.
Using the numerical nm value as meters makes the energy a billion times too small.
solution: $\lambda=[$w]\times10^{-9}$ m. Substituting in $E=hc/\lambda$ gives the energy per photon.
